• **Ballot paper:**

questions.question: Namita talks about an example of metamorphic rock. Which of the following can it be?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Marble**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Metamorphic Rocks:

__
 
• Formed when rocks are subjected to high heat and high-pressure changes inside the Earth.
 
• Examples: Gneissoid, slate, schist, marble quartzite, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Generally speaking, all rocks may be classified into three major groups:

 
• Igneous Rocks,
 
• Sedimentary Rocks,
 
• Metamorphic Rocks.

Igneous Rocks:

 
• Igneous rocks are formed by the cooling and solidification of molten rock (magma) from beneath the earth's crust.
 
• Examples: Granite, Gabbro, Basalt, etc.

Sedimentary Rocks:

 
• Sedimentary rocks are formed by the process of weathering and cementation or precipitation on the Earth's surface. 
 
• Example: Sandstones, shales, limestones, Mudstones, etc

questions.question: Who among the following was NOT a ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukunuddin Tughlaq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rukunuddin Tughlaq was a ruler of the Delhi sultanate for less than **seven months in 1236**.
 
• He belongs to the **slave dynasty**.
 
• He ascended the throne after the death of his father **Iltutmish**.
 
• The misadministration led to rebellions against Ruknuddin and was arrested and imprisoned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**Muhammad-Bin-Tughlaq**__

__
 
• Jauna Khan succeeded his father in AD 1325 under the title of Muhammad- bin-Tughlaq.
 
• He was the most learned scholar of his time and knew both Arabic and Persian and had a comprehensive knowledge of philosophy, astronomy, logic, mathematics, and physical science.
 
• The Sultan maintained good relationships with foreigners and received an envoy from the Chinese ruler.
 
• Toghan Timur (AD 1341), came to seek permission to rebuild Buddhist Monasteries, in the Himalayan region which was destroyed during the crucial expedition.
 
• The Sultan gave permission and sent Ibn Battuta to the court of the Chinese emperor in 1347.
 
• Ibn Battuta was a traveler from Morocco. 

**Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq**__

__
 
• He was the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
• His father was a Turk and his mother was a Jat woman of Punjab.
 
• He founded the city of Tughlaqabad.
 
• He died in 1325, from the collapse of a wooden pavilion.
 
• The tomb of Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq (situated near Tuglaqabad fort) is the first tomb constructed within the walled enclosure which is polygonal in shape.

**​Firuz Shah Tughlaq**__

 
• Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq was a Muslim ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty and he reigned over the Sultanate of Delhi.
 
• He ruled from 1351 to 1388.
 
• Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq was forced by rebellions to concede virtual independence to Bengal and other provinces.
 
• Tughlaq established Sharia across his realm.
 
• Firoz Shah Tughlaq's autobiography is titled Futuhat-e-firozshahi.

questions.question: What is the chemical name of the ionic compound NaCl?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium chloride**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium chloride**

 
 
• Sodium Chloride is also known as **Salt**.
 
• It is an ionic compound with the chemical formula **NaCl**.
 
• It has a ratio of** 1:1** of sodium and chloride ions, With molar masses of 22.99 and 35.45 g/mol respectively.
 
• Sodium chloride is used in the Solvay process to produce** sodium carbonate** and **calcium chloride**.
 
• In the **Mannheim** process and in the Hargreaves process, sodium chloride is used for the production of sodium sulfate and hydrochloric acid.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lithium chloride**

 
 
• Lithium chloride (LiCl) is deliquescent and crystallizes as a hydrate (**LiCl.2H2O**), while other metal chlorides do not form hydrates.
 
 
 
• Calcium** fluoride**
 
 
• In Calcium Fluoride the 4** Calcium ions **are linked with **8 Fluoride ions**.
 
 
 
• **Calcium iodide**
 
 
• Calcium iodide is an inorganic compound that is made of calcium and iodine.
 
• It has the chemical formula CaI2.
 
• Calcium iodide can be formed using either calcium oxide, calcium carbonate, or calcium hydroxide with **hydrochloric acid**.
 
• Calcium iodide is used in **medicines**.
 
• It is used in **photography**.

questions.question: ______ indicates the realm of living organisms and their interactions with the environment.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Biosphere.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** biosphere** is the area of the planet where life can** develop and coexist.**
 
• It is the **region of the planet **that is capable of **supporting life.**
 
• The biosphere is also referred to as the** ecosphere**, and it refers to the global composition of **all ecosystems.**
 
• **Photosynthesis** is used in an open system to **absorb solar energy **at a rate of roughly** 130 Terawatts annually.**
 
• The system is nearly in an** energy equilibrium **and **self-regulating.**
 
• All living things and their relationships, including their interactions with the **lithosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and atmosphere**, are collectively referred to as the **biosphere.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atmosphere:**

 
 
• The **gaseous layers **that envelop a planet or other** celestial bodies **make up its atmosphere.
 
• About **78% of the gases **in the Earth's atmosphere are nitrogen, **21% are oxygen,** and **1% **are other gases.
 
 
 
• **Hydrosphere:**
 
 
• The **entire amount of water** on a planet is known as the hydrosphere.
 
• Water that is present on the **planet's surface**, beneath, and in the atmosphere all belong to the hydrosphere.
 
 
 
• **Lithosphere:**
 
 
• The** rocky exterior of Earth** is known as the lithosphere.
 
• It is composed of the **uppermost layer of the upper mantle** and the brittle crust.​

questions.question: Which of the following Acts of 1947 regulates the Indian labour law with regard to trade unions as well as individual workmen?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Industrial Disputes Act**__**. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The **Indian Labour Law** is governed by the **Industrial Disputes Act, 1947** in as much as it relates to** trade unions **and specific workers employed in any industry on the Indian mainland.
 
• The Act also establishes:
 
 
• a clause that provides for the** worker to be compensated** in the event of a **shutdown, layoff, or retrenchment.**
 
• the process for obtaining** advance approval **from the relevant government to** lay off employees, retrench them or shut down** industrial facilities.
 
• the steps to be taken in response to** unfair labour practices** by an **employer, a trade union, or employees**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Councils Act:**

 
 
• The **Indian Councils Act of 1861** was an Act of the British Parliament that changed the way** India's executive council operated** such that it operated as a cabinet with a** portfolio structure**.
 
• **Six "ordinary members" **made up this cabinet, each in charge of a different division of the **Calcutta government: the home, revenue, military, law, finance, and (from 1874) public works.**
 
 
 
• **Charter Act:**
 
 
• The East India Company's** monopoly over India **was broken by the **Charter legislation of 1813.**
 
• Yet, the business was able to maintain its monopoly in** commerce with China **and** trade in tea with India.**
 
 
 
• **Rowlatt Act:**
 
 
• **The Imperial Legislative Council,** British India's legislature, passed the** Rowlatt Acts in February 1919**.
 
• The acts permitted the **incarceration of suspects without a trial **and allowed for the trial of some political crimes without juries.

questions.question: The Ministry of Labour & Employment launched ___________ under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) scheme in March 2022.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Donate-a-Pension initiaive.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A program under the **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) Yojana** is called **Donate-a-Pension.**
 
• It enables users to **donate the maximum amount** of their **direct support team.**
 
• These individuals could be your **housekeepers, chauffeurs, helpers, caregivers, etc.**
 
• The program is important because over **93% of all workers **in the nation are employed in the **unorganized sector.**
 
• Depending on the** beneficiary's age,** donations can be made for as little as** Rs 660 or as much as Rs 2,400.**
 
• The** minimal contribution** for those who wish to donate is** one year.**
 
• After a subscriber reaches th**e age of 60,** they are eligible to receive a pension of at least** Rs 3,000 per month.**
 
• The spouse will be eligible to** receive 50% **of the beneficiary's pension if the subscriber passes away while they are receiving it.
 
• If a **subscriber passes away before turning 60,** the surviving spouse may join and carry on the plan by making successive regular contributions.
 
• He or she is allowed to **exit the scheme **as per provisions of **exit and withdrawal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The Government of India introduced Stand-Up India on** April 5, 2016.**
 
• In order to establish a **Greenfield Projec**t, the Stand-Up India scheme aims to make bank loans between **10 lakh and 1 crore** available to at least **one SC or ST borrower** and **one woman borrower **each bank branch.
 
 
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana:**
 
 
• To establish a **universal social security system **for all Indians, particularly the** poor, the underprivileged**, and those working in the** unorganized sector, **the Atal Pension Yojana (APY) was introduced on** May 9, 2015.**
 
• At the **age of 60, **subscribers will start receiving the **guaranteed minimum monthly pension **of **Rs. 1000, Rs. 2000, Rs. 3000, Rs. 4000, or Rs. 5000.**
 
 
 
• **India Water Pitch-Pilot-Scale Start-up Challenge:**
 
 
• India Water Pitch-Pilot-Scale Start-up **AMRUT 2.0 **established a challenge to** promote creativity and design**.
 
• The purpose is to **enable startups** in the water and **used-water sectors** to **expand via innovation and design**, which will** provide employment opportunities** and support economic growth.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides equal protection of the laws and equality before the law?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 14**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 14 deals with The Right to Equality.
 
• Article 14:
 
 
• ​Articles 14-18 deal with the Right to Equality.
 
• Equality before the law.
 
• The state shall not deny to any person equality before the law or equal protection of the law within the territory of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 30**

 
 
• **​**Minorities are granted the freedom to create and run their educational institutions. Also known as the "Charter of Education Rights," Article 30.
 
• Article 30(1)
 
 
• States that every linguistic and religious minority has the freedom to create and run educational institutions of their choosing.
 
 
 
• Article 30(2)
 
 
• Prohibits the State from discriminating against any educational institution because it is run by a minority, regardless of religion or language, while providing funding to educational institutions.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Article 42**
 
 
• Article 42 insists that the State should ensure just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.
 
• Article 42 of the Constitution is a non-government organization operating in the sphere of protection of human rights facilitating the protection of civic and political rights and freedoms, as well as the protection of other fundamental rights recognized by international law.
 
• **Harmonization of state policy and national legislation with international standards.**
 
 
 
• ​**Article 60:**
 
 
• ​Article 60 of the Indian constitution talks about the** Oath or affirmation by the President.**
 
• It states that** “Every President and every person acting as President or discharging the functions of the President shall, before entering upon his office, make and subscribe in the presence of the Chief Justice of India or, in his absence, the senior most Judge of the Supreme Court available.”**
